claims: The 2026 World Baseball Classic is from March 4–17.
In the U.S., the 2026 World Baseball Classic is exclusively on FOX networks (FOX, FS1, FS2) and FOX Sports app/Tubi.
The semifinals of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are USA vs. DOM and ITA vs. VEN on March 15-16.
The Championship game of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is on March 17 at 8 p.m. ET.
Streaming of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is available on FOXSports.com and Tubi.
The finals location of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is Miami, FL.
Alternative viewing options for the 2026 World Baseball Classic include YouTube, Facebook, and MLB.TV (varies by region/global).
Pool play matches of the 2026 World Baseball Classic began on March 4.
The finals of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are on March 17.
